summary: Round-2 cleanly addresses both round-1 majors and the two priority minors (focus-restore on onSelect; disabled '+ Create' rendered as a real <button> with title tooltip). The active-only computation is centralized in a single activeProjects ref consumed by both sortedProjects and atLimit, eliminating the stale-current and false-positive limit risks identified earlier. Test coverage grows from 16 to 22 specs and now exercises AC-19 soft-deleted filtering, AC-30 active-only enabled-create, the SSR absolute-URL branch of extractPath, the mid-fetch race, and outside-click / Escape close behaviours. The remaining round-1 minors were explicitly deferred with reasons in decisions.md and are not re-flagged. No new issues introduced.
